Question 48
?

Given the series S=∑n=1∞n3+3n2n4, which of the following is true?

a
The series converges by the comparison test
b
The series is a divergent p-series
c
The series is a convergent p-series
d
The series diverges by the comparison test
e
The series diverges because n3+3n2n4→0 as n→∞
Don't Know
